fee_notes: Charles Schwab franchise uses a unique 'Net Payout' model with no traditional royalty or marketing fee as a % of gross sales. Instead, Schwab retains revenue and remits a net amount to the franchisee after debiting fees. Key ongoing fees include: (1) Association Fee: currently $250/month (cap $500/month); (2) Sublease Rent: $2,000–$11,000/month (3-year avg $4,059/month); (3) Activation Branch Fee: $1,500/month during pre-opening occupancy; (4) Facilities Fee: $5,400–$18,800/month (3-year avg $10,714/month); (5) Branch Hardware and Connectivity Service Fee: $325/month during activation, $860–$2,460/month post-opening for minimum 2 workstations (~$100/month per additional workstation); (6) Client Servicing Fee: currently $2.00/account/month (cap $4.00/account/month), applies only to accounts with avg daily balance >$10,000; (7) Reassigned Client Fee: 1–5x Non-Advisor Assets Revenue Rate × aggregate market value of reassigned household assets, paid in 60 equal monthly installments; (8) Centralized Supervision Fee: up to $5,000/month per Franchise Branch (conditional); (9) Required Licensing Fee: $2,000/month per Franchise Branch (conditional, if required licenses not held); (10) Insurance Fee: typically $175–$355/month per registered representative (pass-through); (11) CAP Charges: variable, based on client accommodations and promotions; (12) Client Complaint Settlement or Sanction: varies; (13) Policy Violation Fee: up to $10,000/month; (14) Transfer Fee: $25,000; (15) Management Fee: 50% of monthly Net Payout during FBO absence; (16) Client Account Purchase Fee: 4% of market value of assets transferred away; (17) Interest: greater of 10% per annum or prime rate + 5% per annum on negative balances/late payments; (18) Reassigned Prior Association Client Fee: 4% of market value of reassigned prior association client assets; (19) Network Meeting Registration Fees: up to $1,000/person/year.
raw_excerpt:
Name of Fee Amount Due Date Remarks
Association Fee (Note 1) Currently, $250 per month Debited monthly as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout for the month
Sublease Rent (Note 2) $2,000 to $11,000 per month, but it could be lower or higher. Debited monthly as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout for the month Tables included in Note 2 provide additional information on monthly Sublease Rent ranges.
Activation Branch Fee (Note 3) $1,500 per month Debited monthly as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout for the month
Facilities Fee (Note 4) $5,400 to $18,800 per month, but it could be lower or higher. Debited monthly as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout for the month.
Branch Hardware and Connectivity Service Fee (Note 5) For the required minimum of two workstations, $325 per month during the Activation Branch Occupancy and $860 to $2,460 per branch (with the $2,460 including up to $1,500 for upgraded network connectivity), per month after the Opening Date, but can be higher depending on additional equipment requests. For each additional workstation, the Branch Hardware and Connectivity Service Fee increases by approximately $100 per workstation. Debited monthly as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout for the month
Client Servicing Fee (Note 6) Currently, $2.00 per account, per month Debited monthly as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout for the month This fee only applies to accounts with an average daily balance of greater than $10,000.
Reassigned Client Fee (Note 7) 1 to 5 times the amount of the Non-Advisor Assets Revenue Rate for the prior month or the last published Non-Advisor Assets Revenue Rate times the aggregate Market Value of the Schwab Client's total household assets eligible for inclusion in the Asset Based Revenue Amount in the accounts reassigned to FBO's Franchise Branch on the day of the reassignment, regardless of the Market Value of the Schwab Client's total household assets Debited in 60 equal monthly installments over a period of 60 months as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout for the month
Centralized Supervision Fee (Note 8) Up to $5,000 per month per Franchise Branch Debited monthly as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout for the month
Required Licensing Fee (Note 9) $2,000 for each full and partial calendar month per Franchise Branch Debited as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout
Insurance Fee (Note 10) Typically, between $175 and $355 (average) per month per registered representative Debited monthly as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout for the month
Client Accommodations and Promotions ("CAP Charges") (Note 11) The amount is based upon the size of the CAP Charges and the amount for which you are responsible. We will debit your portion of the value of any CAP Charge in the month the CAP Charge is given as part of our reconciliation in determining your Net Payout for the month.
Client Complaint Settlement or Sanction (Note 12) Will vary based on particular situation. Upon demand.
Policy Violation Fee (Note 13) Maximum of $10,000 per month. Upon demand.
Transfer Fee (Note 14) $25,000 Payable prior to transfer.
Management Fee (Note 15) 50% of your monthly Net Payout beginning at the time of your absence from actively operating the Franchise Branch and running for the duration of your absence. Debited monthly during the period of your absence.
Client Account Purchase Fee (Note 16) 4% of the market value of the assets that a Franchise Branch Client asks us to transfer to the next financial services firm Within 30 days after we issue you an invoice for the Client Account Purchase Fee.
Interest (Note 17) Greater of 10% per annum or prime rate plus 5% per annum, not to exceed the maximum amount permitted under applicable law.
Reassigned Prior Association Client Fee (Note 17) 4% of the market value of the assets in accounts of Reassigned Prior Association Clients. Payable as part of your Net Payout reconciliation in the month that Reassigned Prior Association Client accounts are assigned to your Franchise Branch.
Network Meeting Registration Fees (Note 18) Up to $1,000 per person per year Before Network Meeting begins
